title: Charge and circuits
scope: Use your school’s topic list to select the ideas you need. These are original practice questions with illustrative values and suggested self-marking guidance, not official Cambridge papers.

objectives.label: Explain charging by electron transfer and attraction of neutral objects.
objectives.note: Use conservation and charge signs, distinguish polarisation from net charge, and explain the role of grounding.

objectives.label: Explain complete circuits and calculate current from charge and time.
objectives.note: Draw a low-voltage series loop with an ammeter and apply equal steady charge-flow rates around one loop.

objectives.label: Distinguish conserved charge from transferred electrical energy.
objectives.note: Use V = E/Q; explain energy changes in the source and lamp without claiming that electrons are consumed.

objectives.label: Calculate resistance and interpret current–voltage behaviour.
objectives.note: Use R = V/I, identify proportional data, explain temperature-dependent lamp resistance, and connect a voltmeter in parallel.

objectives.label: Compare series and parallel circuits using current and potential difference.
objectives.note: Apply charge conservation at junctions; explain shared branch voltage and how an added branch changes total current.

objectives.label: Explain protective devices and choose safe circuit-investigation precautions.
objectives.note: Distinguish fuse protection from shock prevention; explain earth fault paths and keep all planned investigations away from mains.
